definitions.gloss: to store up; to hoard; to accumulate; to stockpile
definitions.explanation: To collect and keep things over time, often implying saving more than necessary or keeping things that could be discarded. Can refer to physical objects, money, or abstract things like stress.

⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溜|た}め{込|こ}まない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溜|た}め{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I've been stockpiling food in preparation for a disaster.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE: ⟦{溜|た}める→溜める：02068_tameru⟧ (to save/accumulate) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to put into)

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Takes an object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (-む type)
- {溜|た}め{込|こ}まない (negative)
- {溜|た}め{込|こ}みます (polite)
- {溜|た}め{込|こ}んで (te-form)
- {溜|た}め{込|こ}んだ (past)

USAGE:
{溜|た}め{込|こ}む often has a slightly negative connotation, suggesting excessive accumulation or hoarding. Compare with ⟦{溜|た}める→溜める：02068_tameru⟧ which is more neutral.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溜|た}め{込|こ}む - to bottle up stress
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溜|た}め{込|こ}む - to accumulate frustration
- ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溜|た}め{込|こ}む - to hoard things
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溜|た}め{込|こ}む - to let work pile up

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
